baseline_selection: most frequent completed JSON; ties by lexicographic JSON, then first sample
frozen_artifact_rule: adopted instruction of final development task in frozen input order
gold_comparison: exact nullable string equality; no post-hoc normalization
ambiguity_policy: only explicitly labeled primary contact; ambiguous fields are null
heldout_policy: generate new sealed inputs after freezing the instruction; no adaptation on heldout
inconclusive: pilot only; do not claim small gains; report saturation and clustered paired differences
isolation: dedicated VM with synthetic evidence only; no runtime database, device credentials or approval channel
campaign_status: approved; run only after preregistration and isolation checks

price_reservation.policy: Reserve before forwarding; reconcile successful validated usage at reservation rates; retain full bounds for unknown liabilities; cumulative ledger includes all prior pilots; ADR-0003

supersedes: protocol.json; accounting only; prior requests remain cumulative
